description: Implementation of RDKWindowManager functionality including display creation, key intercepts, event handling, and lifecycle management within a plugin architecture.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing window management, display creation, key intercepts, and event dispatching.

classes.name: CreateDisplayRequest
classes.description: Data structure representing a request to create a display, including synchronization primitives.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager plugin, sets environment, and starts the main thread loop.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops threads, and unregisters listeners.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a display based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: GetClients
methods.description: Retrieves list of connected clients.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercept
methods.description: Adds a key intercept for blocking specific key events.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercepts
methods.description: Adds multiple key intercepts.

methods.name: RemoveKeyIntercept
methods.description: Removes a key intercept.

methods.name: AddKeyListener
methods.description: Adds key event listeners for a client.

methods.name: RemoveKeyListener
methods.description: Removes key event listeners for a client.

methods.name: InjectKey
methods.description: Simulates a key press event.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Simulates multiple key events for a client.

methods.name: EnableInactivityReporting
methods.description: Enables or disables inactivity reporting.

methods.name: SetInactivityInterval
methods.description: Sets inactivity timeout interval.

methods.name: ResetInactivityTime
methods.description: Resets inactivity timer.

methods.name: EnableKeyRepeats
methods.description: Enables or disables key repeat functionality.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves current key repeat status.

methods.name: IgnoreKeyInputs
methods.description: Sets whether to ignore key inputs.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables or disables input events for specified clients.

methods.name: KeyRepeatConfig
methods.description: Configures key repeat parameters.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Internal method to initiate display creation process.

methods.name: isClientExists
methods.description: Checks if a client already exists.

methods.name: lockRdkWindowManagerMutex
methods.description: Attempts to acquire mutex lock with timeout fallback.

methods.name: toLower
methods.description: Converts client name to lowercase.
